vehicles.title: Volkswagen ID. Buzz

vehicles.title: Heavy cruiser motorbike
vehicles.summary: A 45-degree V-twin cruiser modelled in code to a Fat Boy-style bike's published sizes. Forty parts come off.
vehicles.credit: Modelled in code by the ExpertCarCheck GLB machine. No maker's model, badge or lettering.

vehicles.title: Supersport motorbike
vehicles.summary: A 600 cc inline-four supersport modelled in code to an R6-style bike's published sizes. Fifty-nine parts come off, from the fairing panels to the chain.
vehicles.credit: Modelled in code by the ExpertCarCheck GLB machine. No maker's model, badge or lettering.

vehicles.title: 125 cc scooter
vehicles.summary: A 125 cc scooter modelled in code to a PCX125-style scooter's published sizes. The seat lifts over the storage bin, both stands swing down and fifty parts come off.
vehicles.credit: Modelled in code by the ExpertCarCheck GLB machine. No maker's model, badge or lettering.
